objects.taxonomy_description: A small, flat, baked food item typically characterized by a crisp or chewy texture and sweet flavor profile.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Coloration: The item displays warm earth tones ranging from golden brown to dark brown, indicative of the Maillard reaction during baking.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Material_and_Context: The object lacks biological structures such as skin, fur, or limbs, and presents as a static, non-living edible artifact.

objects.taxonomy_description: A croissant is a buttery, flaky, viennoiserie pastry distinguished by its crescent shape and laminated dough structure.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Overall_Shape: The object exhibits a distinct crescent or half-moon curvature with tapered ends.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Surface_Texture: The exterior displays visible, thin, flaky layers resulting from the lamination process.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Material_and_Context: The item is clearly a baked food product, lacking any biological features such as fur, scales, or leaves.

objects.taxonomy_description: Bowed stringed instrument with a curved wooden body approximately 35 cm long. Body has an hourglass shape with C-bouts (inward curves) on each side. Top plate (soundboard) is spruce with two f-shaped sound holes. Back plate is maple with a distinctive flame pattern. Four strings (G, D, A, E) run from a tailpiece at the base over a bridge to tuning pegs in the scroll. Neck extends from the body to a carved scroll at the top. Fingerboard is ebony (black). Varnish finish is amber, reddish-brown, or golden. Chin rest is attached at the lower left. Bow is a wooden stick with horsehair.
